source.licenseNote: Do not infer a new license from this specimen file; preserve upstream OSM/OSMnx attribution requirements when redistributing source-derived data.

selectionRule: Use a small explicit set of highway-tagged OSM ways visible in the source blob; preserve original way/node IDs and consecutive-node relations. Include one structurally degenerate highway-tagged way as an adversarial case.

ways.name: Beethovenstraße
ways.adversarial: highway-tagged but contains no node-to-node relation in this specimen

derivedRelationsPolicy: For each way with at least two nodeRefs, create one relation for each consecutive pair; a one-node way yields zero relations and must not be treated as a connected graph merely because it carries a highway tag.
